title: Beyond DFT electronic band structures via dual-space orbital learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19919v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate electronic band structures are essential for predicting material properties, but high-fidelity calculations are computationally demanding. We introduce O-kRystal, a dual-space orbital-learning framework that uses a lower-cost Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) calculation as both an energy baseline and a source of structured orbital information. Combining PBE band energies with real- and reciprocal-space orbital matrices, O-kRystal predicts higher-level corrections for individual electronic states as a function of crystal momentum and spin. For states within 5 eV of the band-edge midpoint, it predicts Heyd-Scuseria-Ernzerhof (HSE06) band energies with a mean absolute error of $0.171 \pm 0.009$ eV across nearly 6,000 three-dimensional materials spanning insulating, metallic, magnetic, and nonmagnetic systems. translated_title: 通过双空间轨道学习超越DFT电子能带结构
translated_abstract: 精确的电子能带结构对于预测材料性质至关重要，但高保真度的计算往往需要高昂的计算成本。我们提出了O-kRystal，一个双空间轨道学习框架，它将成本较低的Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE)计算同时用作能量基线和结构化轨道信息的来源。通过将PBE能带能量与实空间和倒易空间的轨道矩阵相结合，O-kRystal能够预测单个电子态作为晶体动量和自旋函数的更高精度修正。对于距带边中点5 eV以内的电子态，在涵盖绝缘体、金属、磁性和非磁性体系的近6000种三维材料上，该方法预测Heyd-Scuseria-Ernzerhof (HSE06)能带能量的平均绝对误差为0.171 ± 0.009 eV。在一个包含六种强关联材料的独立基准测试中，该方法将相应的PBE能带能量MAE降低了68.7%，并能分辨……
tldr: O-kRystal框架利用低成本的PBE计算提供的实空间与倒易空间轨道信息，以约0.171 eV的平均绝对误差预测高精度HSE06能带结构，大幅降低了高保真电子结构计算的成本。
